description: Plan v7 section 4.6: 'Generated depth and cumulative expansion budgets reset for each locale attempt.' The expansion half is covered by runtime-limits-expansion-fallback-budget; this fixture covers the depth half. With maximumGeneratedPlaceholderDepth 2, fr's Deep is a three-link chain that breaches the limit while en's is a two-link chain that sits exactly on it, so a permissive walk must reach en with a depth counter seeded back to 0. en and fr are different primary languages, so tiebreakers are absent.
